title: Biomes

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Biomes are regions in the world of Valheim that can be distinguished by their unique aesthetics, as well as the creatures and resources contained within. Additionally, almost every biome is the domain of one of the Forsaken.

table_data.Description: Starting biome of new worlds filled with Birch, Beech, and Oak trees which is inhabited by low level mobs.
Dark and hostile forest of Fir and Pine trees with more resources, including Corewood, Tin, and Copper.
Found off the coast in deep waters. Home to Leviathans and Sea Serpents.
Dangerous, shadowy area with shallow water full of Leeches, Crypts filled with Draugrs, and poisonous Blobs.
table_data.Availability (from the world center): From 2000 to 6000 meters (for worlds created after Mistlands update. In older worlds, 2000 to 8000 meters).

table_data.Description: Tall frozen mountains teeming with Wolves and flying Drakes that resist the biome's biting cold.
table_data.Availability (from the world center): Above 50 meters altitude (excluding Ashlands), from 600 meters

table_data.Description: Warm sunny area with golden grass and killer bugs. Home to the Fuling clan, Lox and Deathsquitoes.
A fog-covered land with rocky terrain and Yggdrasil shoots, inhabited by Hares, Dvergrs and hostile insects such as Seekers.
A fiery realm, the terrain changes the more inland one travels, with central parts taken up by lava. The undead army of Charred make up most of the population.
(Unfinished)Snow-capped hills with frozen rivers in the far north of Valheim.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The term "biome" comes from the ecological concept of the same name.
• At Valheim's launch in February 2021, five of the planned nine biomes were made available to explore. The other four were accessible, but lacked any meaningful content.

full_text:
Biomes

Introduction. Biomes are regions in the world of Valheim that can be distinguished by their unique aesthetics, as well as the creatures and resources contained within. Additionally, almost every biome is the domain of one of the Forsaken.

Trivia. • The term "biome" comes from the ecological concept of the same name.
• At Valheim's launch in February 2021, five of the planned nine biomes were made available to explore. The other four were accessible, but lacked any meaningful content.
